note: Fresh nationwide Page Profit Check nightly batch. Ten public small-business opportunities only; one isolated worker per opportunity; no outreach is sent.

items.name: A Honey Do List Handyman Services LLC
items.vertical: handyman services, fencing, painting, deck staining, flooring, minor electrical, minor plumbing
items.summary: Handyman Wix site has real project photos, email, phone, and a strong no-job-too-small positioning, but the homepage makes visitors scroll through broad project blocks before a clear estimate path.
items.angle: keep the owner-operated handyman feel while clarifying service categories, near-top trust proof, and a faster free-estimate CTA.

items.name: Personalized Touch Cleaning Service
items.location: Hackensack / Northern New Jersey and NYC metro
items.vertical: residential cleaning, commercial cleaning, specialty cleaning
items.summary: Cleaning site already states its NJ/NY service area and free-estimate offer, but the first screen and service cards are generic and do not quickly separate residential, commercial, and specialty buyers.
items.angle: preserve the clean apartment/office visual style while making service paths and estimate requests clearer above the fold.

items.name: Flawless Handyman Service
items.vertical: handyman repairs, installations, maintenance, drywall, painting, electrical, carpentry, flooring, plumbing
items.summary: Orange County handyman site has detailed service lists, quote forms, phone/email, and a testimonial, but spelling issues, long dense lists, and duplicated contact flows weaken trust and mobile scanning.
items.angle: keep the high-coverage handyman services feel while turning long lists into buyer-friendly repair paths with stronger quote CTAs.

items.name: Sergent's Cleaning Services
items.summary: Cleaning site has email, phone, local service language, and a simple form, but the page leans on generic Wix service-company copy and does not explain packages, trust proof, or next steps clearly.
items.angle: preserve the simple local cleaning-company tone while adding clearer residential/commercial paths and a quote-first flow.

items.name: VIP Home Improvement Specialists, Inc.
items.vertical: home improvement, windows, doors, hurricane-resistant upgrades
items.summary: Home-improvement site has 30+ years experience, phone/email, and service pages, but the misspelled email/domain signals, generic sections, and buried estimate path create trust friction.
items.angle: keep the VIP Treatment/home-improvement positioning while surfacing experience, services, and estimate steps sooner.

items.name: A Deep Clean Cleaning Services
items.location: Raleigh / Wake County and eastern NC
items.vertical: deep cleaning, move-in/move-out cleaning, recurring cleaning, vacation/concierge services
items.summary: Cleaning site has a broad service area, promotion, Thumbtack rating claim, email, and phone, but Wix residue, fake testimonial copy, and mixed service categories dilute conversion trust.
items.angle: preserve the practical cleaning-service Wix look while separating cleaning packages from concierge extras and removing template leftovers.

items.name: B&B Home Improvement LLC
items.vertical: licensed general contractor, remodels, maintenance, kitchen, bath, flooring, wainscoting, lighting
items.summary: Licensed GC site has license numbers, real project categories, review proof, phone/email, and strong service fit, but the homepage hierarchy and free-estimate CTA can be much clearer.
items.angle: keep the remodel portfolio/project-photo feel while lifting license proof, project categories, and estimate next steps into a sharper first-screen flow.

items.name: Pixi Cleaning Services
items.vertical: house cleaning, deep cleaning, weekly/biweekly/monthly cleaning, one-time cleaning
items.summary: Cleaning site has a friendly tagline, insured claim, service-frequency options, email, and phone, but the top copy is generic and the quote path is not organized around buyer intent.
items.angle: preserve the warm home-cleaning feel while clarifying deep, recurring, and one-time cleaning paths with a more specific contact CTA.

items.name: Ultimate Handyman, LLC
items.vertical: licensed handyman, small remodels, upgrades, tile, repair projects
items.summary: Licensed handyman site has a license number, strong craftsmanship language, phone/email, and project-specific detail, but visitors need a clearer service overview and estimate path before reading long descriptions.
items.angle: keep the craftsman/project-detail personality while moving license proof and free-estimate actions into a cleaner scan path.

items.name: C&L Home Improvement LLC
items.vertical: roofing repair, gutters, roof replacement, home improvement
items.summary: Roofing/home-improvement site has phone numbers, email, and estimate language, but spelling issues, generic Wix service cards, and unclear service hierarchy reduce confidence for higher-value projects.
items.angle: preserve the straightforward contractor style while cleaning up credibility, service paths, and the free-estimate process.
